name: 透明防霉磁吸垂坠浴帘款
description: 通透帘身、磁吸下摆压边、水珠顺面滑落，卫浴干爽不闷

styleLock.backgroundSystem: bright tiled or mint-painted bathrooms plus one deep charcoal feature wall and one warm wood-plank wall, always with a hanging rod and a tub or shelf anchor
styleLock.lightingSystem: soft diffused daylight from the left, low contrast, gentle contact shadow at the hem, controlled thin specular streaks along folds and droplets, no harsh hotspot
styleLock.surfaceSystem: glossy white tub acrylic, matte tile floor, oak plank ledge and pale wooden shelf
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, single headline line per screen, all copy carried by placeholders
styleLock.iconSystem: thin lake-teal ringed callout discs and one bottom wave band, single accent colour, no filled pictograms
styleLock.presentationRules: panel always hung with true gravity folds or folded into a neat stack; rod hardware and hem weights rendered as generic geometry only; scale stable across the set
noDrift: no human figure or face in any bathroom frame
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent airy clean-bathroom commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pale mint field #DCEAE6, lake-teal accent #6FB3AE, warm off-white base #F4F1EA and deep charcoal text #33383D; neutral daylight colour temperature; background system of bright tiled bathrooms with one deep charcoal feature wall and one warm wood-plank wall; soft diffused daylight from the left, low contrast, gentle contact shadow at the hem and controlled thin specular streaks on wet surfaces; modern geometric sans-serif with a single headline line per screen; thin-line lake-teal ringed callout discs and one bottom wave band as the only graphic devices; product always presented as a hung or neatly folded transparent panel with true gravity folds and unchanged hardware; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐图事实：01 薄荷色卫浴里帘身满高垂挂、左侧大圆形主张标压住三分之一的画面；02 深灰石纹主卫、弧形金属吊杆、帘收在一侧；03 暖木墙前帘身挂直，三个青色圆环微距窗分别看孔眼五金、表面水珠、下摆配重，左下另有虚线标注框；04 淋浴水雾里的放松人像；05 帘边压得笔直、地面干爽并放一条卷起的毛巾；06 清晨淋浴的活力人像；07 明亮窗边浴缸与泡泡浴玩具；08 深色墙与绿植、木质浴缸托盘，帘在画面左缘隔雾。品类判定依据：提示类目在家居日用/卫浴用品与家纺布艺之间摇摆，按图取主产品为无电无机的卫浴功能软帘，主打通透、疏水与下摆压边而非织造面料，故定 家居日用/卫浴用品，源平台挂载类目未采信。已剥离内容：源品牌字标与其脚丫图形、圆形标与底部波浪带内的全部原句营销文案、图中尺寸数值、材质名称与气味类断言、四张图内可辨识成人与儿童的面容及肢体（改为无人物或仅留道具与手部否定项）、青色波浪带与圆环上的角标排版字样与原平台店铺字样；Amazon 徽章与星级未保留；信任与收口镜改用空白印章框、空白按钮与空白标记位，不内联任何认证、检测、销量或评分事实。
